spans.s: Pauṇḍra^1 (“king of the Puṇḍras or Pauṇḍras”). § 233 (Svayaṃvarap.); I, 187, †7020 (Kaliṅga-VangādhipaPāṇḍya-Pºāḥ, present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).-§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 84 (only C., B. has Tuṇḍaḥ).
Pauṇḍra^2, the conch-shell of Bhīmasena. § 576 (Bhagavadgītāp.): VI, 25, 844 (mahāśaṅkhaṃ).--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 51, 2115 (do.).

Pauṇḍra^3, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 223 (Vāsishṭha): I, 175, 6684 (arose from the froth of Vasishṭha's cow).--§ 342 (Indralokābhigamanap.): III, 51, 1988 (sa-Pºoḍrān, had been present at the rājasūya).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 365 (only C.).--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 50, 2081 (only B., C. has Huṇḍāḥ), 2083 (only C., B. has Puṇḍrāḥ, in the army of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 4, 122 (had formerly been vanquished by Karṇa); 11, 396 (had formerly been vanquished by Kṛshṇa).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 20, 802 (º-Matsyakāḥ, in the army of Duryodhana).--§ 607 (Karṇap.): VIII, 45, 2084 (KāśaPºāḥ).--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 65, 2430 (enumeration of barbarous and low peoples).--§ 739 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 35, 2158 (degraded to śūdras). Cf. Pauṇḍrika, pl., Puṇḍra, pl.
Pauṇḍraka (king of the Puṇḍras) = Vasudeva^3, I, 6992 (Vº); II, 584 (Vº), 1270 (Vº). Cf. Pauṇḍra, Puṇḍrādhipa.
Pauṇḍramātsyaka, a king. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2679 (incarnation of the Asura Balīna).
Pauṇḍrika, pl. (ºāḥ), a people = Pauṇḍra, pl. § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1872 (brought tribute to Yudhishṭhira).
